summary.text: KC Ohaebosim is a Democratic member of the Kansas House of Representatives representing District 89 (Sedgwick County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the House since 2017.
KC Ohaebosim is listed as the ranking minority member of the Energy, Utilities and Telecommunications Committee.

paragraphs.text: KC Ohaebosim is listed as a member of the Energy, Utilities and Telecommunications Committee, the General Government Budget Committee and the Transportation Committee.
